scope: Disjoint engine-test authorship only; no engine, card, synthetic or generated edits. Tests deliberately distinguish provenance plans and original payment resumes.
fixture_contract: Thread-local immutable rules overlays only; all physical names, printed mana costs, colors, kinds and ownership remain actual metadata. Parent Konstrari Charm retains RG noncreature cost; its test-only no-target program draws one to prove paid completion. Child once-only output is enforced by tapping. Restricted mana is produced through a real tagged activation, not by directly editing a lot.

expected_rules.risk: Direct borrowed BF/exile and GY source adapters lose guided allocation feasibility.
expected_rules.outcome: With ordinary G1 + creature-activation-only G1 and child G/tap -> R, spending the ordinary G strands noncreature parent RG. Only restricted-lot1 is consumed; lot0 is neither offered nor accepted; parent resolves Draw1 with zero remaining mana. Singleton viable allocation may auto-commit under existing UI rules.

expected_rules.risk: Nested native/indexed/attachment/acquired/borrowed child PayCosts forgets frozen parent.
expected_rules.outcome: All six nested adapters enforce the same complete-plan constraint. Attachment tap-mana is taxed generic1 by an immutable fixture; all other child templates cost one G.

One spare ordinary G makes both lot0 and lot1 viable, with independently different remaining restriction provenance. Standalone or declinable optional windows also keep both legal; optional parent may decline after spending ordinary G.

expected_rules.risk: Owned allocation plan is shared, lost, or replayed twice.
expected_rules.outcome: Actual pending allocation survives raw/index equivalence, parent disposal and snapshot restore; restored alternate lot choice completes with the correct different remaining lot.

expected_rules.risk: Fixed-output announced child loses non-Priority guided resume.
expected_rules.outcome: Actual Rubble Rouser tap+exileGY -> fixed R resumes original Plot or face-up payment for Slickshot Show-Off 1R, or optional resolution payment. Source is tapped, exact GY card exiled, reflexive damage queued but not resolved until the parent finishes. Mountain direct fixed R preserves the window and direct fast path.

expected_rules.risk: Optional pay-or-decline and owned fixed receipt continuation regress.
expected_rules.outcome: Optional payment remains both payable and declinable after child output. Owned raw/index/restore of child payment resumes PlotPayment, spends once, plots exactly once and deals one reflexive damage.
